title: Senior Waiter / Sommelier
experience: They are committed to delivering an elevated dining experience through impeccable service, attention to detail, and genuine hospitality
description_text:
Our client is a renowned fine dining restaurant in Malta, specialising in premium steaks, exceptional cuisine, and an outstanding wine selection. They are committed to delivering an elevated dining experience through impeccable service, attention to detail, and genuine hospitality.
 Position Summary
 Our client is seeking an experienced and passionate Senior Waiter / Sommelier to join their front-of-house team. The successful candidate will provide exceptional table service while guiding guests through the restaurant's wine selection, recommending food and wine pairings, and ensuring every guest enjoys a memorable fine dining experience.
 Key Responsibilities
 Deliver exceptional food and beverage service in a professional, attentive, and friendly manner.
 Welcome guests and ensure an outstanding dining experience from arrival to departure.
 Recommend wines that complement menu selections and provide expert food and wine pairing advice.
 Present and serve wines according to fine dining service standards.
 Maintain a thorough knowledge of the food and beverage menus.
 Assist guests with menu recommendations and answer questions confidently.
 Ensure tables are prepared and maintained to the highest standards.
 Coordinate closely with the kitchen and bar teams to ensure smooth and efficient service.
 Handle guest feedback professionally and resolve any concerns promptly.
 Support and mentor junior members of the front-of-house team when required.
 Maintain cleanliness and organisation throughout the restaurant.
 Follow all food safety, hygiene, and health and safety standards.
 Requirements
 Has extensive experience in premium restaurants.
 Possesses excellent wine knowledge, including food and wine pairing.
 Delivers outstanding customer service with confidence and professionalism.
 Has a strong understanding of fine dining and premium steak restaurants.
 Speaks fluent English. Maltese candidates are encouraged to apply.
 Is reliable, well-presented, and enjoys working within a high-performing team.
 What We Offer
 Opportunity to work in one of Malta's premier fine dining restaurants.
 Professional and supportive working environment.
 Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
 The opportunity to work alongside a passionate and experienced hospitality team.
 Career progression within a growing hospitality business.
 Join Our Client's Team
 If you have a passion for fine dining, exceptional wines, and delivering unforgettable guest experiences, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and become part of a team dedicated to excellence in hospitality.
